image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a large Triceratops statue or animatronic in an outdoor enclosure. The dinosaur's head dominates the frame, showing three horns and a large frill. A human woman stands to the right for scale, looking up at the creature. The background includes trees, a fence, and sunlight filtering through leaves.
